summary: Rocky Point Lookout in the Clearwater National Forest began with a 1934 log crib and L-4 cab, gained its R-6 cab on a concrete base in 1963, and was registered in 2009.

facts.design: R-6 flat cab on a 10-foot concrete base

events.note: 10-foot log crib topped by an L-4 cab; first used this year.
10-foot concrete base with R-6 flat cab; NHLR says it replaced the L-4 cab on the crib.
Known staff listed for 1974-1975 by Idaho Fire Lookouts.
Known staff listed for 1990-1991 by Idaho Fire Lookouts.
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register, April 24, 2009.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: All sources agree on the 1934 crib and L-4 cab and the 1963 concrete base with R-6 cab; no conflict found in the sources read.

sources.title: Clearwater National Forest Lookouts (list compiled June 2016)

notes_for_editor: Brief elevation 1914.1 m matches NHLR (6,280 ft, 1,914 m); firelookout.com says 6280'. Brief height_m 3.0 corresponds to the 10-foot base only; no total height in sources, so it is left out of facts. Access level is not stated by any source (NHLR says relatively easy access from Powell, not visitor rules), so access is omitted. Keeping Watch's Rocky Point page gives coordinates 46.58222, -114.66587, which match this tower, but has no history. No fire, closure or move found in the sources read. Do not confuse with a separate West Central Idaho 'Rocky Point Lookout' (log cabin, 1936 per the Idaho Fire Lookouts search snippet, reported burned in 2015); that page was seen only in search results and was not read.
